hero.titleLead: Run a modern, real-time fundraising auction
hero.subtitle: BidConnect gives your organization its own branded auction site where bidders compete live from their phones, proxy bidding handles the back-and-forth automatically, and instant alerts keep everyone engaged until the final bell. Behind the scenes, everything syncs straight into Salesforce — contacts, items, and winning bids flow in automatically, so your team can focus on the event, not the spreadsheet.

features.f1Text: Proxy bids, tiebreakers, and instant outbid alerts. Supporters set a ceiling and let it run, and everyone hears the second they lose the lead — so items keep moving without anyone working the room.
features.f2Text: Contacts, items, and bids sync automatically. Every participant’s activity is written back to your own org, not just the winners, so the audience you built is still there next year.
features.f3Text: A branded, isolated site for your organization. Your subdomain, your logo and your time zone, with no other charity’s data anywhere near it.

record.title: Most auction software remembers only the winner.
record.text: Everyone else — the bidder who raised once and stopped, the one who chased an item to the final minute and lost — is gone when the event closes. BidConnect keeps every participant’s activity on every item and writes it into Salesforce, alongside the rest of your donor data, permanently: how many times each person bid, how high they were willing to go, what they contested and what they let pass. That record is yours to keep and to work — which items and categories drew real competition, which fell flat, and who to call before next year’s catalogue is set. Analysed, visualised and reported on down to a single bidder and a single item.

how.title: Four steps to a live auction.
how.intro: No paper bid sheets, no clipboard, no spreadsheet afterwards. Set it up, share the link, and the event runs itself.

items.question: Auctions eat staff and volunteer time. Does this actually reduce that?
items.answer: Substantially, and in the places that hurt most. The evening runs itself: no paper bid sheets, nobody running totals on a clipboard, no chasing the room at closing, no typing winners into a spreadsheet and then into your database. Bidding, closing, winner notification, payment links and the write-back to Salesforce all happen without anyone standing over them. Your team spends the night talking to supporters instead of administering an auction. Sourcing the items is still yours, because that is relationship work — everything downstream of it is handled.

items.question: Only a handful of wealthy guests ever bid. How does this widen the room?
items.answer: Bidding happens in a web browser, so it is not limited to whoever is standing near the table. People who came to socialise can bid from where they are, people who could not attend at all can take part, and proxy bidding lets someone set a limit and stop watching. The practical effect is more people bidding on more items, for the whole of your auction window, rather than a few contests at the front of the room.

items.question: Items rarely sell above retail. Why would that change?
items.answer: Price comes from competition, and competition needs people to know they have been outbid while there is still time to respond. That is exactly what BidConnect automates: outbid alerts go out in seconds rather than at the next announcement from the stage, and proxy bidding keeps a serious bidder in the running while they are eating dinner. It removes the most common reason a bid stops short — nobody noticed — and keeps items moving right up to the close.

items.question: How do we know whether the auction was worth running at all?
items.answer: Because you keep the evidence. Not just the total raised, but which items drew real competition and which got one bid, which categories pulled, who bid and stopped, and who went deep and lost. It is all in your Salesforce org the moment the auction closes, so next year’s catalogue, ask amounts and invitation list are decisions based on what actually happened rather than on what people remember.

items.question: What still takes work on our side?
items.answer: Sourcing the items, and that should be yours — it is relationship work, and it is where your team adds something software cannot. What BidConnect does is make sure that effort pays off for longer than one night. Every item you secure gets a catalogue page, a live bidding record, and a permanent entry in your Salesforce org showing exactly who wanted it and how hard they chased it. The evening runs itself, and what it produces is still working for you next year.

items.question: How is this different from other auction software?
items.answer: Most systems record the winning bid and discard everything else. BidConnect keeps every participant’s activity on every item — how often they bid, how high they were prepared to go, what they contested and lost — and writes it into your Salesforce org, where it stays. You finish the night with your audience, not just your receipts.

items.question: Do we need Salesforce to use it?
items.answer: Yes, and that is the advantage. BidConnect runs on your own Salesforce org with StoreConnect for the catalogue and checkout, so your items, prices and contacts live where your team already works. Everything the auction produces flows back into the same place, which means no export, no import, and nothing to reconcile the following week.

items.question: How do bidders take part? Is there an app to install?
items.answer: No app, and nothing for your supporters to learn. They open your auction’s web address on a phone, tablet or laptop, register with an email address and confirm it, and bid. Confirming the address is required before a first bid, so the bidder list reaching your Salesforce org is real from the start.

items.question: What is proxy bidding?
items.answer: A bidder sets the most they are willing to pay instead of watching the item. BidConnect then bids on their behalf, only as far as it needs to, and stops at their limit. It keeps people in contention who are eating, talking or not in the room at all. Ties are settled by a tiebreaker amount, so two identical maximums never deadlock.

items.question: How are bidders told when they are outbid?
items.answer: By email, within seconds of losing the lead, with a link straight back to the item. You can add text alerts as well by connecting a messaging provider to your account. Texts are opt-in and stay under the bidder’s control: they tick a box, give a mobile number, and can turn them off from their account page whenever they like.

items.question: What happens when the auction closes?
items.answer: Everything settles itself. Winners are worked out per item, then consolidated into one cart per person, so someone who wins four things pays once. That cart is pushed to StoreConnect and each winner is emailed their payment link, which only they can open. No checkout queue, and no one reading names off a clipboard.

items.question: Can one organization run more than one auction?
items.answer: Yes, and the results stay separate. Each auction has its own window, and every bid and engagement record is tied to the auction it happened in — so a returning bidder’s history builds up year on year instead of overwriting itself. By your third event you can see who bids every time, who has been drifting, and what each of them chases.

items.question: What do we actually see in Salesforce?
items.answer: Your bidders as Contacts, one record per bidder per item per auction with their bid count, ceiling and whether they won, and a summary per person per auction. Open a Contact and you see the auctions they took part in, what they chased and what they won. It is reportable like any other Salesforce data, so it feeds the same dashboards and campaigns your team already runs.

items.question: Do we get our own web address?
items.answer: Yes. Each organization gets its own subdomain carrying its own branding, logo and time zone, isolated from every other organization on the platform. Supporters see your auction and your name throughout, with nothing to suggest a shared system behind it.

items.question: What if we only run one event a year?
items.answer: That is a common pattern, and it is priced for. Put the account into a dormant state between events and everything is kept — your Salesforce connection, your items, your past results — at a much lower monthly cost. One click brings it back with nothing to set up again, so next year’s auction starts from where the last one finished.

items.question: When in the year should we run it?
items.answer: AFP Global published an analysis of more than 4,200 nonprofit auctions and over three million bids placed during 2024. March, April and November were the highest-grossing months, while summer and early-winter events lagged. Average item prices, though, peaked in December and January — so a smaller holiday auction can carry higher-value lots. Those are sector averages, and your supporters are not the sector. Each auction here has its own start and end, so you can move the date freely and compare one year against the next on your own numbers.

items.question: How many items should we list?
items.answer: The rule of thumb in that same analysis is one item per four attendees. Both extremes cost you: too few leaves money on the table, and too many splits the same bidders across more lots so nothing gets contested. BidConnect gives you what you need to get it right for your own audience — every item carries its own bid count, so after the event you can see precisely which lots drew a crowd and which drew one polite bid, and build the next catalogue on that.

items.question: Which kinds of items actually perform?
items.answer: The sector data splits them usefully. Pets, travel and experiences, and wine and dining draw the most bids. Sports and hobbies, priceless experiences such as naming rights or a behind-the-scenes day, and arts and entertainment sell for the highest amounts. Those are two different jobs, and a strong catalogue does both: items that get the room competing, and items that carry the total. Every item here keeps its category, and that category travels with each engagement record into Salesforce — so after your first event you can answer this from your own results instead of an average.

items.question: What should we set as the starting bid?
items.answer: The common guidance is to open at 30 to 50 percent of what an item is worth, and every item has a starting bid you set, so that is simple enough to apply. From there the pace belongs to your bidders: they can name an amount, raise by whatever they choose, or set a maximum and let proxy bidding carry them. Nothing caps a raise at a preset step, so an item that catches fire is free to run. Open low enough to invite the first bid and the competition does the rest.

items.question: Is online bidding really better than paper bid sheets?
items.answer: Markedly. That analysis puts online bidding around 30 percent ahead of paper on revenue — directional rather than exact, since the records come from a single platform, but the mechanism is plain enough. A bid sheet on a table is visible only to whoever walks past it. An item in a live catalogue is visible to everyone at once, including the people who could not come, and that is the same effect behind an average winning bid of nearly $380 across those three million bids. BidConnect keeps every item in front of every supporter for the whole of your auction window.

items.question: Can supporters see the catalogue before bidding opens?
items.answer: Yes, and it is worth building into your plan. Before the start time you set, your auction site shows the items with prices hidden and bidding closed, so you can send people to the real catalogue in the weeks beforehand rather than to a holding page. Previewing items early is one of the practices the sector data associates with stronger results, and it costs nothing but the email.

slider.title: What Can AI Agents Do For Your Business?

analytics.title: AI-Driven Analytics
analytics.description: Unlock powerful insights into your customer behavior. Access custom AI-driven metrics that help you understand your users, track engagement patterns, and improve your audience segmentation. Our intelligent analytics dashboard surfaces actionable data, helping you identify high-value customers, optimize conversion funnels, and make data-backed decisions that drive growth.

support.title: 24/7 Customer Support
support.description: Never miss a customer inquiry again. Our AI agents work around the clock, providing instant responses to customer questions at any time of day or night. Whether it's 3 PM or 3 AM, your customers receive immediate, helpful assistance that keeps them engaged and satisfied. This continuous availability ensures you capture every opportunity and maintain customer trust, even outside business hours.

instant.title: Instant Response Times
instant.description: Say goodbye to long wait times. Our AI agents respond to customer inquiries in milliseconds, dramatically reducing response times from hours or days to seconds. This immediate engagement keeps customers interested, prevents them from bouncing to competitors, and creates a seamless experience that modern consumers expect. Fast responses lead to higher satisfaction rates and increased conversion.

qualification.title: Automated Lead Qualification
qualification.description: Let AI handle the heavy lifting of lead qualification. Our intelligent agents ask the right questions, gather essential information, and automatically score and route leads based on their potential value. This ensures your sales team focuses only on high-quality prospects, saving time and increasing close rates. The system learns from every interaction, continuously improving its qualification accuracy.

costs.title: Reduced Operational Costs
costs.description: Significantly lower your customer service expenses while improving quality. AI agents handle routine inquiries at a fraction of the cost of human agents, allowing you to scale support without proportionally scaling headcount. Reduce overhead costs including training, benefits, and infrastructure while maintaining or even improving service quality. The savings compound as your business grows.

scalable.title: Scalable Customer Engagement
scalable.description: Handle thousands of simultaneous conversations without breaking a sweat. Unlike human teams that require hiring and training to scale, AI agents can instantly accommodate traffic spikes, seasonal surges, or rapid business growth. Whether you're handling 10 or 10,000 conversations, maintain the same high-quality experience for every customer without additional costs or delays.

items.question: Can I try it before committing to a paid plan?
items.answer: Absolutely. We offer a free trial so you can experience exactly how an AI agent works for your business before making any financial commitment. Set up your agent, test it with real scenarios, and see the results for yourself. We're confident that once you see the time saved and leads captured, you'll understand the value immediately.

items.question: Will AI agents make my customer interactions feel impersonal?
items.answer: Not at all. Modern AI agents are designed to provide warm, conversational experiences that feel natural and helpful. They can remember customer preferences, use friendly language, and seamlessly hand off to human agents when a personal touch is needed. Many customers actually prefer the instant, judgment-free assistance AI provides for routine questions, while your team remains available for complex situations.

items.question: What if the AI gives wrong information to my customers?
items.answer: AI agents are trained specifically on your business information and configured with guardrails to stay within their knowledge boundaries. When they encounter questions outside their scope, they're designed to acknowledge limitations and escalate to human support rather than guess. You maintain full control over the information they share, and continuous monitoring helps identify and correct any issues quickly.

items.question: Is my business too small to benefit from AI agents?
items.answer: AI agents are particularly valuable for small businesses because they let you compete with larger companies without hiring additional staff. A solo entrepreneur can offer 24/7 support, and a small team can handle inquiry volumes that would otherwise require multiple employees. Our tiered pricing means you only pay for what you need, making AI accessible regardless of your business size.

items.question: How long does it take to set up an AI agent?
items.answer: Most businesses have their AI agent live within minutes, not weeks. Our no-code platform lets you configure your agent by simply providing your business information and preferences. No technical expertise required, no developers to hire, and no complex integrations to manage. You can start capturing leads and answering customer questions the same day you sign up.

items.question: Will I lose control over my customer relationships?
items.answer: You gain more control, not less. AI agents capture detailed information about every interaction, giving you insights into what customers are asking, what they need, and where they're coming from. You set the rules for how the AI responds, when it escalates, and what information it collects. Every conversation is logged and accessible, so you're always informed about what's happening with your customers.

items.question: What happens when the AI can't answer a question?
items.answer: Smart escalation is built into every AI agent. When a question falls outside the AI's knowledge or a customer requests human assistance, the conversation is seamlessly handed off to your team with full context. The AI can collect contact information and schedule callbacks, ensuring no inquiry falls through the cracks even outside business hours.

items.question: Are AI agents secure? What about my customers' data?
items.answer: Security is foundational to our platform. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest, we never store payment card information, and we maintain strict compliance with privacy regulations. Your customer data belongs to you and is never used to train models or shared with third parties. We undergo regular security audits to ensure your information stays protected.

items.question: Will my customers know they're talking to an AI?
items.answer: Transparency builds trust. Our AI agents can introduce themselves honestly while still providing excellent service. Research shows customers appreciate knowing they're interacting with AI when it means faster responses and 24/7 availability. The key is delivering genuine value—customers care far more about getting their questions answered quickly than whether a human or AI is helping them.

items.question: What if AI technology changes and my investment becomes obsolete?
items.answer: Our platform continuously evolves with AI advancements, and your subscription includes all updates automatically. As the technology improves, your AI agent gets smarter without any additional effort or cost on your part. You're not locked into outdated technology—you're partnering with a platform committed to keeping you at the forefront of AI capabilities.
